ideas.pitch: A lightweight, training-free semantic router built in Python that uses kNN over an exemplar index to dynamically route user prompts to the most efficient LLM, featuring real-time LLM-judge writeback.
ideas.title: VibeRouter: Self-Optimizing LLM Semantic Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the winning pattern of engineering hard functionality like semantic routing and leverages modern AI-assisted coding tools to deliver high technical execution within the strict 90-minute limit.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted compliance checking tool that parses BPMN workflows and runs pre-deployment risk diagnosis for multi-agent systems.
ideas.title: BPMN Agent Risk Diagnostician
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on rigorous technical execution and governance, standing out to judges looking for structured problem understanding and functional utility.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined reasoning optimization wrapper that wraps LLM calls to enable more efficient, multi-step problem solving without massive latency.
ideas.title: HyperReason: Token-Efficient LLM Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep technical execution and optimization, aligning with the criteria for creativity and technical prowess in rapid development challenges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered offline code reviewer designed for fast, local execution to provide immediate feedback on code smells and security antipatterns.
ideas.title: SnapReview: Offline AI Code Linter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core focus of the hackathon: turning a rapid development problem statement into a working product using modern development tools and AI assistance.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config auto-embedding and RAG toolkit that hooks directly into local databases to give AI models immediate context over unstructured documentation.
ideas.title: AutoTOON: Instant RAG & Embedding Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Offers high functional utility and a polished UI/UX out of the box, satisfying multiple judging categories simultaneously in a tight timeframe.
